content: 9front's arm64 kernel port lives in sys/src/9/bcm64 (Raspberry Pi 3/4), derived from Richard Miller's legacy Plan 9 RPi port. It is hardware-oriented (mailbox, GPIO) but contains reusable GIC-400 (=GICv2, matching qemu -M virt,gic-version=2) and PL011 UART code. 9front arm64 images boot under QEMU on ARM hosts, proving the stack works virtualized.
